nova_reel_v1_0.label: Nova Reel v1.0
nova_reel_v1_0.prompt_guidance:
Nova Reel generates video from descriptive captions — describe a scene that already exists, not a command.
Structure: subject + action, environment, lighting, style, then camera motion at START or END of prompt.
NEVER use negation (no/not/without) — the model generates what you negate.
Supports 20+ camera movements: dolly in/out, pan left/right, tilt up/down, arc shot, zoom in/out, track left/right, aerial shot, following shot, whip pan, pedestal up/down, slow motion, time-lapse, hyperlapse.
Use specific adjectives (serene, ornate, weathered) not generic ones (beautiful, amazing).
Quality markers help: 4k, cinematic, photorealistic, shallow depth of field.
Single shot: 512 chars max. Keep concise and vivid.

ray_v2_0.label: Ray v2.0
ray_v2_0.prompt_guidance:
Ray v2.0 excels at natural language understanding — describe what you want to see with rich detail.
Handles physics, human expressions, object interactions, and creative/whimsical concepts with high realism.
Write in flowing natural language, like a screenplay direction — include subject, action, mood, lighting, camera.
Camera movements from natural descriptions (no fixed keywords needed): 'slow dolly forward', 'orbit left', 'tracking shot'.
Supports up to 5000 characters — use the space for vivid scene-setting and emotional tone.
Stronger with creative concepts than rigid technical specifications.
Durations: 5s or 9s. Aspect ratios: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9, 9:21.

requirements._note: 32B model on g6e.4xlarge (1× L40S 48 GB VRAM, 128 GB RAM). BnB NF4 quantization requires CUDA — no device_map override (loads layer-by-layer to GPU, peak ~13 GB). NF4 transformer (~10 GB) + text encoder (~5 GB) = ~15 GB total. With preserved NF4 cache: S3 download + direct GPU load = ~2 min cold start.

invoke.prompt_guidance:
FLUX.2 dev by Black Forest Labs. Uses Mistral 3 text encoder — understands natural language exceptionally well.

KEY CONSTRAINT: FLUX.2 does NOT support negative prompts. DO NOT write a NEGATIVE: line. All quality must come from the positive prompt alone.

WRITING RULES:
- Keep prompts 60–100 words. Concise and precise beats verbose. Every word must earn its place.
- DO NOT use negation words ('no', 'not', 'without', 'avoid') — describe only what IS in the image.
- Front-load: Subject + key action in the FIRST sentence. Model attention drops after ~80 words.
- Write as one flowing description, not a list of tags or comma-separated keywords.
- Be specific: 'weathered copper roof with verdigris patina' not 'old roof'.

STRUCTURE (this order, one sentence each):
1. Subject: who/what, pose, expression, key details
2. Setting: where, 2–3 environmental details
3. Light + camera: one lighting note + one lens/angle note
4. Style anchor: end with a short style phrase

EFFECTIVE STYLE ANCHORS (pick one):
- 'cinematic still, anamorphic lens'
- 'editorial photograph, natural light'
- 'concept art, digital painting'
- 'documentary photography, 35mm film grain'
- 'hyperrealistic render, octane'

EXAMPLE (good — 72 words):
'A weathered sea captain in his 60s sits in a teak deck chair, navy peacoat unbuttoned, gold epaulettes catching amber light, squinting blue-grey eyes fixed on the horizon. Behind him, the ship's railing and open ocean stretch to a misty coastline. Late afternoon golden hour from the left, shallow depth of field. Cinematic portrait, 85mm f/1.4, editorial photography.'

AVOID:
- Microscopic details the model cannot render (individual thread counts, exact button positions)
- Repeating the same concept in different words (padding)
- Generic quality tags that add nothing ('stunning', 'beautiful', 'amazing')
- Describing what is NOT in the image

qwen_image_edit_bf16.label: Qwen-Image-Edit
qwen_image_edit_bf16.description: Reference-guided image editing by Alibaba Qwen. Apache-2.0 (commercial-safe). Takes 1–3 reference images + an instruction to preserve a subject/product/character while changing theme, background, wardrobe, lighting. The 2511 refresh over 2509 mitigates image drift, improves character consistency, adds integrated LoRA, and strengthens geometric reasoning. Powers the Image Studio reference-guided tab and the basic Edit tab (inpaint/outpaint).

key_terms: Modification and redistribution allowed with license notice
No additional gating — weights are openly downloadable from HuggingFace

requirements._note: BF16 (~57GB) needs MULTI-GPU with ENOUGH PER-GPU VRAM. VERIFIED: ml.g6e.12xlarge (4xL40S, 48GB/GPU). device_map=auto shards the transformer, and the handler places the non-sharded text_encoder+VAE on GPU0 — this needs headroom BEYOND GPU0's transformer shard. TESTED + REJECTED: ml.g5.12xlarge (4xA10G, only 22GB/GPU) — the GPU0 transformer shard fills its 22GB, leaving no room for text_encoder/VAE -> CUDA OOM at load + VAE-fp32 fails (2026-07-30, endpoint reached InService but broken). So total VRAM fitting is NOT sufficient; PER-GPU VRAM must exceed one shard + the non-sharded comps. g5 (22GB/GPU) unusable until the handler caps device_map max_memory to reserve GPU0 room or CPU-offloads non-sharded comps on tight-VRAM GPUs. g6e.24xl = same 48GB L40S (should work, untested). AVOID single-GPU (48<57) and single-GPU g7e/Blackwell (cu124 DLC lacks SM12.0 kernels). Not quantized — highest quality.

invoke.prompt_guidance: Qwen-Image-Edit is an INSTRUCTION-FOLLOWING image editor, not a text-to-image generator. Write an imperative edit instruction, not a scene caption. Structure: (1) name the subject to KEEP from the reference (product, logo text, character identity, distinctive colors/shape), then (2) state the change to apply (new background, scene, wardrobe, lighting, mood). Example: 'Keep the red yogurt cup and its green leaf logo exactly; place it on sunlit beach sand at golden hour with soft rim light.' Be specific about what is preserved so identity survives. Quote any on-product text verbatim so the label stays legible (Qwen renders text well). Describe ONLY the new elements — do not re-describe unchanged parts of the reference. Keep it concise and directive (~40-70 words); avoid flowery prose, negations, and camera jargon. For multi-image references (product + logo, or a character from several angles), treat them as complementary views of ONE subject — optimal with 1 to 3 images.

qwen_image_bf16.description: Text-to-image generator (BF16 full precision, multi-GPU — highest quality) by Alibaba Qwen. Apache-2.0 (commercial-safe). 20B MMDiT with strong prompt following and exceptional text rendering (incl. non-Latin scripts). The 2512 refresh over the August base enhances human realism (less "AI look"), finer natural detail (fur/landscapes), and text rendering accuracy. A deployable custom generator alongside the Bedrock models. Its editing sibling, Qwen-Image-Edit, is a separate deploy.

key_terms: Modification and redistribution allowed with license notice

TESTED + REJECTED: ml.g5.12xlarge (4xA10G, only 22GB/GPU) — the GPU0 transformer shard fills its 22GB, leaving no room for text_encoder/VAE -> CUDA OOM at load + VAE-fp32 fails (2026-07-30, endpoint reached InService but broken). So total VRAM fitting is NOT sufficient; PER-GPU VRAM must exceed one shard + the non-sharded comps. g5 (22GB/GPU) unusable until the handler caps device_map max_memory to reserve GPU0 room or CPU-offloads non-sharded comps on tight-VRAM GPUs. g6e.24xl = same 48GB L40S (should work, untested). invoke.prompt_guidance: Qwen-Image is a 20B text-to-image generator with excellent prompt following and best-in-class TEXT RENDERING (including non-Latin scripts). Write a rich natural-language description of the finished image. Structure: Subject → Action/Pose → Environment/Scene → Lighting → Composition/Camera → Style. Front-load the most important elements (the model attends most to what comes first). It follows detailed prose well, so be specific about materials, colors, and mood. STANDOUT STRENGTH: it renders embedded text (signs, labels, posters, titles, UI, logos-as-text) crisply — when text should appear IN the image, quote it verbatim in double quotes and say where it goes (e.g. a neon sign reading "OPEN"). Prefer positive description over negations; put exclusions in the negative prompt instead of writing 'no/without' in the prompt. Avoid keyword-spam; write like describing a photograph or painting.

invoke.prompt_guidance:
HunyuanImage 3.0 is an 80B MoE autoregressive text-to-image model by Tencent.

KEY: This deployment runs the base checkpoint in plain text-to-image mode; it does NOT auto-enhance prompts. ArtSmoker's own prompt pipeline handles enhancement upstream, so send a clear, well-formed prompt.

WRITING RULES:
- Write naturally, 30–80 words. Describe what you want to see.
- DO NOT use negative prompts — not supported.
- Front-load the subject. Background and style details follow.
- Bilingual: works equally well in English and Chinese.
- Supports dynamic resolutions up to 2048×2048.

STYLE BEHAVIOR:
- The model's default aesthetic leans toward stylized digital art / illustration.
- For photorealistic results, use photography language: "photograph", "photo", "shot on", "natural lighting", "candid" — the model responds to these cues.
- For artistic results, describe the art style: "oil painting", "watercolor", "concept art", "digital illustration".
- Avoid rendering engine jargon (PBR, subsurface scattering, AAA quality) — use natural visual descriptions instead.

STRENGTHS:
- Exceptional text rendering in images (English + Chinese)
- Superior compositional understanding from autoregressive architecture
- High-fidelity details at large resolutions
- BF16 = original model precision, zero quality loss

requirements._resource_note: PROVEN baseline: ml.g5.2xlarge (A10G 24 GB, 32 GiB RAM, ~$1.52/hr). Confirmed 2026-06-25 — full image→3D run completed cleanly: peak 4.78 GB VRAM (of 24), ~7.5 min inference (459s, excl. ~2 min cold-start model load), 18.8 MB PBR GLB. CUDA exts (o_voxel/cumesh/flex_gemm) + xformers build & run fine on Ampere sm_86 via the arch-portable builder. No errors. Chosen over g6e.xlarge (L40S 48 GB) because VRAM was hugely over-provisioned there — the A10G's 24 GB has ample headroom at ~5 GB peak, at materially lower cost. Larger g6e options remain allowed for headroom if needed.
